offline-c.from: run fable-c-m5max-2, submission s0019 (engine of s0011)
offline-c.what: Apple M5 Max (MLX + run-time Metal): exact speculative decoding with one sequence; drafts from the checkpoint's DSpark head (mtp.safetensors) and from n-gram copies of the prompt and output, verified in K-row passes whose every row has the bits of the one-token step; dense BF16 matrices in a lossless 12-bit code decoded to the stored bits (track C on the checkpoint's formats otherwise: NVFP4 / MXFP8 experts as stored); greedy or sampled (temperature, top_p, top_k, seed: a token is the argmax of logits / T plus Gumbel noise hashed from seed, position and token, so its tokens equal its own one-token-per-step tokens either way); prompts prefilled in wide passes of up to 256 rows, served with MK_PREFILL=fast (MLX GEMMs on the stored codes, fused attention: about 1,300 prompt tokens per second, not the step's bits; --prefill exact keeps them); a prefix cache (a request that starts like the cached sequence keeps its K/V); context 16,384 by default, up to 32,768 with --max-context; a request that arrives while another decodes waits for it; --mode step: one token per step
